_README: Character-specific APL VARIABLE overrides, looked up automatically by wowkb.sim.
Two kinds of entry, both fenced so they cannot become the hand-edited-APL failure
`variables` — re-point a variable the UPSTREAM reference APL already declares. The
tool builds the `variable,name=X,value=N` line itself; nothing here is ever pasted
into a profile, and a variable upstream does not declare is rejected loudly.
`apl_append` — append `use_item` rungs BELOW upstream's own priority list. Only
`use_item` lines are accepted (never a damage action), `use_off_gcd=1` is mandatory
(failure #2 was exactly this line without it, -3.2%), and `actions+=/` appends so
Both require `why` and `measured`. An override with no recorded measurement is a
superstition, and this file is exactly where superstitions accumulate. Everything
computed with either active is branded on every row, and the firing gate still runs
unchanged - the point is to make the gate go green HONESTLY.
Run with --no-overrides to see what upstream does unaided.

encomplete.note: Two ON-USE trinkets. Upstream's shipped profile carries only one (Vile Vial of Volatile Venom on-use + Wavecaller's Seastone passive), so its rungs - which gate each trinket on the OTHER's cooldown state - are never exercised in the two-on-use case and deadlock here. Ruled out 2026-08-20: it is not the ilvl tie (bumping trinket2 to 308 changes nothing), not `trinket_priority`, not `damage_trinket_priority`, and not our harness (it reproduces exactly in the stock upstream profile with only the two trinket lines changed). || 2026-08-21: an earlier version of these rungs carried an escape valve, `|cooldown.summon_demonic_tyrant.remains>trinket.N.cooldown.duration`, meant to press anyway when Tyrant was too far out to be worth waiting for. It is DEAD CODE: Tyrant's cooldown (~62s observed) is SHORTER than either trinket's (90s / 120s), so `remains` can never exceed `cooldown.duration`. With and without it the runs are byte-identical. Removed rather than left in looking load-bearing. A `remains>10` grace clause WAS tested and is worse than both (+2.09% vs +2.27% on-cooldown, +3.41% held). || 2026-09-06: GEAR MOVED UNDER THESE RUNGS. trinket1 is now Void-Reaper's Libram (a PROC, not an on-use), so the trinket1 rung is INERT for the current set — it is kept because any variant that puts an on-use back in that index needs it. trinket2 is still Stormbound Emblem of Dazar and the rung is still load-bearing, and it was RE-MEASURED on this gear: common random numbers, 1500 iterations, deterministic=1, threads=1, seed 20260906, 1T/300s — pressed inside Tyrant 131,650 / pressed OUTSIDE Tyrant 126,728 (-3.74%) / never pressed 125,460 (-4.70%). ⚠ Note this rung deliberately CONTRADICTS upstream's own cast-time handling: upstream's items list gates every rung on `trinket.N.cast_time>0` and prefers a cast-time trinket OUTSIDE Tyrant (MID2 profile lines 67-72). For Demonology that is measurably wrong by 3.74% — the Tyrant pet-damage multiplier outweighs the 2s channel it costs. Upstream's preference is not a bug for zero-cast trinkets; it is simply the wrong call for this one on this spec.

apl_append.why: Freightrunner's Flask (90s CD) fires 1.0x/300s under upstream unaided. Holding it for Tyrant gives 3.16x / 15.6% uptime vs 3.64x / 17.9% pressing on cooldown - so holding DOES cost 13% of presses, exactly the tradeoff the 90s-CD-vs-62s-Tyrant-cycle drift implies. It still wins, because Tyrant multiplies pet damage and stats placed inside the window are worth disproportionately more.

Stormbound Emblem of Dazar (120s CD) fires 0x/300s under upstream unaided. Measured on the stock upstream profile, common random numbers, 2500 iterations, 1T/300s Patchwerk: upstream 196,348 -> on-cooldown 200,776 (+2.27%) -> held-for-Tyrant 203,002 (+3.41%). Held also wins at 5T/300s (+1.86% over on-cooldown) and at 120s, where it is FREE - identical press counts, 2.00x either way.
